brief: The same school class bell (a small brass hand bell of a 1960s village school class, about 12 cm tall, polished warm brass with a few dull spots, a turned dark-brown wooden handle on its crown) lying on its side on the ground as if put down by a child, seen from slightly above, its open mouth towards the right with the corner of a white handkerchief peeking out; nothing under it, no ground and no shadow.
